title: 10 被爆恋爱，的孙翔
slug: 全职高手首先你不会被一见钟情
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

孙翔走在楼道里。

嘉世大楼有电梯，走楼梯的人很少，但是孙翔实在不耐烦走电梯，一路下楼他脚步声飞快，外套灌满风心脏也灌满风。

俱乐部大厅里回声空荡荡，孙翔两步上前拉开大门。

冷风和声光影一起涌进他的眼睛，宛如心有灵犀，周珈蓝站在远处路灯下抬起头。

她包得严严实实，孙翔看不清她的脸，只看清四周夜色漆黑，只有她头顶路灯闪亮，像一颗发光的星星。

孙翔握住门把手的手迟疑了一下，慢慢放开，玻璃大门在他身后合拢。

他走过去，脚步刻意地慢下来，一面伸手拨弄刘海，一面把手机拿起来，假装不经意地低头照自己的脸。

他上学的时候不是好学生，每天上课睡觉下课踢球放学打游戏，老师在讲台上讲近乡情怯，他在底下睡得迷迷糊糊，换个姿势继续睡的间隙里听见一句“不敢问来人”。

那个时候不懂，考试不会写也记不住，原来是因为那个时候还没有这样的经历，这样的人。

今晚我输了，来到嘉世的第一场，输得这么难看。

网上是不是有人在骂我，你看到了吗？

你怎么来了？

你也觉得……我输得很难看吗？

越走脚步越慢，果真不敢问来人。

周珈蓝抬头看他，有些时候需要把系统面板放出来，促成一个完成任务的理由，但有些时候好像又不需要。

就像现在，孙翔走过来像个淋湿的大毛绒狗狗，这种时候抱上去不会被推开的。

周珈蓝往前走了两步，越走越快，走出路灯照亮的那一小段路，脚步轻盈地踮起脚尖，扑到孙翔怀里。

孙翔看呆了，怀里忽然一重，他下意识接住，周珈蓝很轻所以不成负担，再重一点也没问题，他的肌肉练得很好。

脑子里还在一遍一遍过她跑过来的那一幕，脚步那么轻盈，姿态那样美好，简直像游戏过场cg里的女角色，小腿上蹁跹着发光的蝴蝶。

系统提示音在周珈蓝脑海中响起。

【任务：在嘉世俱乐部楼下与孙翔拥抱。】

一个【完成】的绿戳打在上面。

口罩遮盖下周珈蓝嘴角勾起弧度，脸颊上露出一个萌萌的酒窝。

角落里不知何时架起摄像头，镜头捕捉到这一幕，咔嚓一声按下快门。

孙翔毫无所觉，呆呆站着抱了一会儿才知道问，“你冷不冷？”

匆匆地去抓周珈蓝的手，“嘶，怎么冰凉，我带你去吃夜宵。”

周珈蓝推了推他，摇摇头，细声细气的，“不吃啦。”

她是来抱孙翔的，抱完了，就可以走了。

走之前要说什么？

周珈蓝歪了歪头，握紧拳头对孙翔说，“比赛加油。”

又说，“早点睡，晚安。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Sun Xiang was walking in the corridor.

Excellent Era Building has an elevator, and there are very few people taking the stairs, but Sun Xiang is really impatient to take the elevator. His footsteps are fast all the way downstairs, and his coat is filled with wind, and his heart is filled with wind.

The echo in the club hall was empty, and Sun Xiang stepped forward and opened the door.

The cold wind, sound, light and shadow rushed into his eyes, and as if he had a telepathic connection, Zhou Jialan stood under the street lamp in the distance and raised his head.

She was wrapped so tightly that Sun Xiang couldn't see her face clearly. He could only see the darkness around her and the streetlight above her head shining like a shining star.

Sun Xiang's hand holding the door handle hesitated for a moment, then slowly let go, and the glass door closed behind him.

He walked over, deliberately slowing down his pace, reaching out to fiddle with his bangs, picking up the phone, pretending to look down at his face casually.

He was not a good student when he was in school. He would sleep in get out of class and play football and games every day. The teacher would talk on the podium about his fear of being close to his hometown. He fell asleep underneath, and when he changed his position and continued sleeping, he heard the words "I don't dare to ask anyone."

I didn’t understand it at that time, I couldn’t write or remember it in the exam. It turned out to be because I didn’t have such an experience or such a person at that time.

I lost tonight. It was my first game in Excellent Era, and I lost so ugly.

Someone is scolding me online, have you seen it?

Why are you here?

Do you also think... it looks ugly for me to lose?

The further I walked, the slower I walked, and I really didn't dare to ask who was coming.

Zhou Jialan looked up at him. Sometimes it was necessary to release the system panel to provide a reason to complete the task, but sometimes it seemed that it was not necessary.

Just like now, Sun Xiang came over like a big stuffed dog that got wet. He wouldn't be pushed away if he picked him up at this time.

Zhou Jialan took two steps forward, walking faster and faster, and walked out of the short distance illuminated by the street lamp. He stood on tiptoes lightly and threw himself into Sun Xiang's arms.

Sun Xiang was stunned. There was a sudden weight in his arms. He subconsciously caught it. Zhou Jialan was very light, so it was not a burden. It would be no problem to be heavier. His muscles were well trained.

The scene of her running over was still playing over and over in my mind. Her steps were so light and her posture was so beautiful. She was like a female character in a CG game cutscene, with glowing butterflies dancing on her calves.

The system prompt sounded in Zhou Jialan's mind.

[Task: Hug Sun Xiang downstairs at Club Excellent Era.】

A green stamp of [Complete] hits it.

The mask covered Zhou Jialan's mouth, and the corners of her mouth curved, revealing a cute dimple on her cheek.

A camera was set up in the corner at some point, the lens captured this scene, and the shutter clicked.

Sun Xiang didn't notice anything. He stood there and hugged him for a while before finally asking, "Are you cold?"

He hurriedly grabbed Zhou Jialan's hand and said, "Hey, it's so cold. I'll take you for a supper."

Zhou Jialan pushed him, shook his head, and said softly, "I won't eat."

She came to hug Sun Xiang. After hugging him, she can leave.

What should I say before I leave?

Zhou Jialan tilted his head, clenched his fists and said to Sun Xiang, "Come on for the game."

Then he said, "Go to bed early and good night."
